name: openserp-unified-failure-decisions-and-00b9
instr:
OpenSERP cannot trace causal failures and recovery decisions consistently across search, extraction, HTTP, cache, and CLI results. Add one report that follows classification through resilience handling to the final outcome without changing established behavior. Recovered failures remain visible, and successful results remain successful.

Equivalent HTTP, proxy, browser, extraction, search-blocked, and API failures share a stable `FailureCategory` but retain distinct `FailureSource` evidence. This includes raw HTTP 429, proxy-auth transport failures, and browser main-document status when available; otherwise preserve typed transport or cancellation causes. `Failure` classification and projections preserve `errors.Is` identity for sentinels and wrapped causes.

Each failure independently declares search retry, extraction fallback, proxy degradation, and circuit-accounting disposition. Thin successful extraction may trigger rendered fallback without becoming terminal or affecting the circuit. Every failed engine attempt produces one decision governing retry termination, proxy health, and circuit accounting. Limiter deadlines record cancellation without degrading proxies or opening circuits. Append cancellation after completed attempts without starting another.

Make `FailureReport` an immutable, ordered snapshot. Sanitize credentials, query secrets, and panic text. Record rejected or failed raw, rendered, and llms.txt candidates in attempted order, identify the winner, and isola
